en: A black‑and‑white photograph bordered by a white margin showing a calm riverbank scene. In the foreground, a small wooden rowboat is pulled up near the shore. Leafless or sparsely leaved trees line the right bank, with one prominent tree leaning over the water. The left side shows a forested bank and gentle hills in the distance under a cloudy sky. Two small human figures appear further down the shore on the right. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the image side.
